objective.name: sandbox.build.batch
objective.description: Build a collection payload for bounded DSL for_each orchestration.

#root.role: Create a deterministic collection of items for later DSL iteration.

transformation_contract.morphing: A simple batch request becomes a deterministic collection used by bounded DSL iteration.
invariants: count is coerced to an integer and clamped to zero when negative.
Each item is generated deterministically as {message: prefix-index, index: index}.
The returned count echoes the normalized count actually used to build the items array.
success: On success, sandbox.build.batch returns items plus the normalized count.
The payload is stable input for DSL for_each and parallel iteration tests.
failure: sandbox.build.batch has no contract-level validation failure for missing prefix or count because defaults are applied locally.
The capability only fails if the underlying wrapper runtime cannot execute.
notes: This capability is intentionally deterministic to make orchestration tests stable.
Items are plain payload objects and do not allocate matter or structure state.
